'''Bardotta''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]' [[Bardotta system/Legends|Bardotta system]] that was ruled by the much beloved [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its inhabitants were reputed for their mysticism and attention to spiritual matters.

==History==
[[File:Bardotta.png|thumb|left|250px|The landscape of Bardotta]]
During the Clone Wars, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] the [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] contacted the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as several of her most trusted spiritual advisers had disappeared, and asked for the help of [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], to come and investigate the unusual situation.<ref name="Disappeared" />

Jar Jar Binks was accompanied by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], even though the Bardottans didn't trust the Jedi (due to Jedi long ago inducting Bardottan Younglings into the Jedi Order; which forever painted the Jedi as Thieves and Kidnappers to the Bardottans) and excluded the Master from several important meetings about the matter. During a meeting with Jar Jar Binks, the queen got abducted so Jar Jar and Mace Windu decided to investigate the underground caves under the [[Bardottan Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] as they thought that that was the best place to look due to info of it leading to a revered place of the Frangawl cult.<ref name="Disappeared" />

The Representative and the Jedi found the secret [[Frangawl Temple/Legends|headquarters]] of the Frangawl cult on [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]] and rescued the Queen, moments before being sacrificed in order to steal her life force, a power which later would land in the power of [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].<ref name="DisappearedII">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Bardotta is named after French actress [[Wikipedia:Brigitte Bardot|Brigitte Bardot]].<ref name="EpGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep608|text="The Disappeared, Part I" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
